title: June Brigman
description: "All three STAR WARS films have great joy-ride scenes," remembers  June Brigman. "The speeder-bike chase from RETURN OF THE JEDI is one of my favorites." Brigman began working as an artist for Marvel Comics at age 22. Although continually active in the comics field, she also works in advertising and produces a monthly comic strip for NATIONAL GEOGRAPHIC WORLD magazine. Brigman is currentlv illustrating a series of STAR WARS Young Adult books for LucasArts.
